cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount recorded from totalHypeValueReturned on cancelWithdrawal, the amount re-delegated by redelegateWithdrawnHYPE

remainder_retained.meaning: the amount % 1e10 remainder of the re-delegated cancelled withdrawal amount is retained in hypeBuffer or otherwise accounted for rather than dropped from re-delegation

caller_has_manager_role.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

claims.scope: redelegateWithdrawnHYPE re-delegation of cancelled withdrawal amounts via _distributeStake SpotDeposit

preconditions.text: A user cancels a withdrawal request via cancelWithdrawal, recording the associated HYPE value (totalHypeValueReturned) in _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.; The caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Re-delegating cancelled withdrawal amounts should not drop the amount % 1e10 remainder; the truncated conversion remainder should be retained in hypeBuffer or otherwise accounted for rather than lost from re-delegation.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Each redelegateWithdrawnHYPE call loses _cancelledWithdrawalAmount % 1e10 HYPE (less than 1e10 wei, i.e. less than 1e-8 HYPE) from the re-delegation process.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The re-delegated amount equals the recorded _cancelledWithdrawalAmount before it is reset to zero.
The remainder is defined as cancelled_withdrawal_amount % 1e10 in wei, bounded above by 1e10 wei (less than 1e-8 HYPE).

limitations: Remainder retention is represented as a grounded Boolean because the predicate grammar cannot express the modulo 1e10 remainder relation directly.
The exact per-call loss magnitude is bounded only as less than 1e10 wei (less than 1e-8 HYPE); no concrete amount is given.
Whether the stranded remainder is permanently unrecoverable is asserted as potential, not demonstrated.
